annotations.text:
Six scenes, read left to right — this is the scroll, storyboarded.

The page stops being a document and becomes a sequence: a call that rang out at 19:02, what it cost, what we build, what it costs you, who we did it for, and the ask. The HUD rails on both edges track where you are, the way the reference sites do.

The motion you can see here is real CSS running now — the breathing headline, the ringing pulse, the drifting gradient inside HOUSTON, the sheen on the button. None of it is a picture of an effect.

Built on animation-timeline: view() and scroll(), position: sticky and clip-path — all native CSS now.

So this is more immersive than the current site AND drops all 167KB of GSAP, ScrollTrigger and three.js.
